events.headline: Hot September CPI report (+0.6% m/m, +3.7% y/y) released Oct 14 drives S&P 500 (-1.11%) and Nasdaq (-1.88%) down sharply on renewed rate-hike fears; Russell 2000 -1.93%

TSMC posts record Q3 2026 profit (+69% y/y, revenue +16.2% q/q) on 'extremely robust' AI chip demand, but shares fall anyway as investors focus on margin pressure from 2nm ramp and cautious 2027 capex tone

Broad chip-sector selloff continues: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index -4.3%, Nvidia -3.2%, ASML -3.94% on Oct 14, amid AI capex/debt-sustainability jitters (CoreWeave debt raise, Oracle CDS spike reports)

Non-Magnificent-Seven tech names sell off on concerns they are using excessive debt to fund AI infrastructure buildout; CoreWeave shares fell sharply after a $2B convertible note offering, Oracle down ~9% intraday on Oct 14
